title: Flugschreiber evidence record
description: One line of an evidence segment, as written by internal/evidence/record.go at schema version 1. The event is hashed as the exact bytes that were written, so a verifier compiled today can still check a chain written by a future version. See docs/SCHEMA.md for the hash construction and the compatibility policy.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number, starting at 1 and contiguous across the whole log.

prev_hash.description: record_hash of the previous record, or 64 zeros for the first record in a chain.

record_hash.description: SHA-256 over the domain-separated preimage documented in docs/SCHEMA.md.

event.description: The event payload. Hashed as raw bytes, so the chain is independent of the schema version a reader was compiled against.
